prompt:
Image 1 is the floor plan of a room seen from above: its bottom edge is the front wall, its top edge the back wall, its left edge the left wall and its right edge the right wall. Image 2 is the front view of the same room (the establishing view), taken from the centre of the front wall facing the back wall. Generate one photorealistic cinematic still of this same room, empty of people, from a new camera position: the left-side view: the camera stands at the centre of the right wall, at eye level, facing the left wall, so the back wall is at the right edge of the frame and the front wall at its left edge. Turn the camera for real: this view must not show the back wall's furniture head-on unless it is the wall being faced. Keep every wall, door, window, piece of furniture, material, colour and light exactly as Image 1 and Image 2 show them, seen from this new side; the room layout and furniture placement exactly match Image 1. Location: INT. JI FAMILY LIVING ROOM. A grand, contemporary villa living room in cream, gold and white marble. Back wall: tall French windows onto a garden of leafy trees, flooding the room with warm afternoon sunlight from the back and slightly from the left, with leaves swaying outside. Centred before these windows is a long cream leather sofa with its back to them, facing the camera. In front of it is a low marble-and-gilt coffee table on a large beige patterned carpet. Left wall: a fat white marble column stands in front of it near the back corner, with an open archway to the entrance hall behind it, the way in and out. Right wall: a marble fireplace with a large abstract painting above it, flanked by a cream armchair. Front wall, behind the camera: built-in display cabinets. Light comes from the sunlight through the back windows and a crystal chandelier overhead.

Avoid: people, readable text, logos, watermark, any door or window the description does not name.
